```{r}
#| include: false
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "coefficients.R"))
```

Across the `r CoefficientsSummary$geometryCount` evaluated geometries and `r CoefficientsSummary$materialCount` material scenarios, the following ranges are the MDE/MCE envelope of the mean coefficients from the `ensemble` set, for three performance regimes of the relative allowable displacement $D_a/H$ — the allowable displacement expressed as a percentage of the slope height. For low relative displacements ($D_a/H$ = `r CoefficientsSummary$regimes[regime == "low", format(signif(DaH.min, 2L), trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)]`–`r CoefficientsSummary$regimes[regime == "low", format(signif(DaH.max, 2L), trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)]`% across the slope heights), the required coefficient approaches the peak acceleration: $k_{\max}$ = `r CoefficientsSummary$regimes[regime == "low", paste0(.fmt(kmax.min, 3), "–", .fmt(kmax.max, 3))]` g ($k_h$ = `r CoefficientsSummary$regimes[regime == "low", paste0(.fmt(kh.min, 0), "–", .fmt(kh.max, 0))]`% PGA). For intermediate relative displacements ($D_a/H$ = `r CoefficientsSummary$regimes[regime == "mid", format(signif(DaH.min, 2L), trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)]`–`r CoefficientsSummary$regimes[regime == "mid", format(signif(DaH.max, 2L), trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)]`%), the coefficient sits in the 50–66% band of the peak acceleration: $k_{\max}$ = `r CoefficientsSummary$regimes[regime == "mid", paste0(.fmt(kmax.min, 3), "–", .fmt(kmax.max, 3))]` g ($k_h$ = `r CoefficientsSummary$regimes[regime == "mid", paste0(.fmt(kh.min, 0), "–", .fmt(kh.max, 0))]`% PGA). For large relative displacements ($D_a/H$ = `r CoefficientsSummary$regimes[regime == "high", format(signif(DaH.min, 2L), trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)]`–`r CoefficientsSummary$regimes[regime == "high", format(signif(DaH.max, 2L), trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)]`%), the coefficient falls to the 25–35% band of the peak acceleration: $k_{\max}$ = `r CoefficientsSummary$regimes[regime == "high", paste0(.fmt(kmax.min, 3), "–", .fmt(kmax.max, 3))]` g ($k_h$ = `r CoefficientsSummary$regimes[regime == "high", paste0(.fmt(kh.min, 0), "–", .fmt(kh.max, 0))]`% PGA).
